title: A2 Milestone 1: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Misión Cumplida! Has superado el primer gran Hito del Nivel A2. ¡Sigue así!

parts.visual: En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 1 a 9 del nivel A2: Present Simple vs Continuous, Stative verbs (know, believe), Responsabilidades (responsible for + ing), Interrupciones con When/While.
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 1 to 9 of level A2: Present Simple versus Continuous, Stative verbs, Responsibilities, and Interruptions with When and While.

parts.visual: También evaluaremos: Estructura de la empresa (Headquarters, subsidiaries), Comparativos/Superlativos, Tecnología (Crashed, froze), Cuantificadores (Much, many), y Present Perfect (For, since).
parts.audio: We will also evaluate: Company structure, Comparatives and Superlatives, Technology issues, Quantifiers, and the Present Perfect with For and Since.

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador.

questions.question: I usually ____ from home, but today I ____ from the office.
I ____ you are right about the budget. (Creo - Verbo de estado).
I am responsible ____ training the new staff.
She is in charge of ____ the budget. (Administrar).
I was typing an email ____ the system crashed. (Cuando).
____ I was waiting for the taxi, it started to rain.
Our ____ are located in Paris. (Sede central).
The CEO reports directly to the ____ of Directors.
This server is ____ than the old one. (Adjetivo corto: fast).
This is ____ project of the year. (Adjetivo largo: important).
My computer ____ and I lost everything! (Colapsó/Se cayó).
Have you tried to ____ the system? (Reiniciar).
We don't have ____ time left. (Tiempo incontable).
There are too ____ people in the room. (Personas contables).
I have worked here ____ five years. (Por).
She has been the manager ____ 2018. (Desde).
Sorry to ____, but I have a question. (Interrumpir).
What do you ____ about this strategy? (Pensar).
How do you ____ about this idea? (Sentir/Opinar).
I completely ____ with you. (Estoy de acuerdo).
